_comment: Android update manifest. Each release: bump versionCode in build.gradle.kts AND here, then upload the APK with: gh release upload current Wander.apk --repo faisal-nabulsi/wander-site --clobber (binaries are NOT committed to this repo).
notes: New: a floating joystick that stays on top of your game — steer while Pokémon GO is open, no app-switching (Pro). Share a spot or route as a link your friends can import. Set a distance goal (walk until N km, then stop) and lock your heading to walk hands-free. Curated hotspots now load from the server with freshness info instead of being frozen into the app.
